rule: A test helper is a non-test package of the root module that no non-test package imports, under any of GOOS=linux, darwin and windows (GOARCH=amd64), and whose path relative to the module has a segment that is `internal` or contains `test` (amendment 3: a public leaf package of a library is imported only by tests, yet it is production code). Test files themselves (`*_test.go`) are never loaded by exp4cg, so they need no rule.
